paragraphs: Lendable's ambition to deliver instant credit and savings solutions aligns with my experience building fast, reliable AI tools for fintech clients.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python, using FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, for a Madrid-based product start-up client, and presented it in a live stakeholder demo.

I wrote a three-tier test framework of about 65 tests across eight files, covering tool-level, API/integration and live agent layers, and validated it during the LLM provider migration from Groq to AWS Bedrock after a rate-limit evaluation.
Could we find twenty minutes to talk about where I could contribute first at Lendable?
